title: syntax
symptoms: The existing parser reports syntax at the recorded tool stage
possible_causes: An unmatched delimiter or missing terminator
inspection_steps: Inspect the first independent syntax error and preceding lines
Compare delimiters, statement terminators and the declared language mode
repair_guidance: Correct the smallest syntactic defect and re-run verification
limitations: A later syntax diagnostic can be caused by an earlier error; the reported token need not be the defect location
